title: docs: DX audit and roadmap update with examples catalog fixes
body:
Full codebase scan (171 schemas, 194 test files / 5,243 tests, 150+ doc pages, 4 examples) to identify DX gaps and update the roadmap.

### Audit Findings

10 issues discovered, most notable:
- `examples/README.md` referenced non-existent `minimal-auth` directory
- `plugin-bi` had no README, no scripts, placeholder-only code
- Examples catalog had stale metadata (version `0.6.1`, count `3`)
- Contracts docs section empty (`pages: []`)
- `app-host` README used `npm run dev` instead of `pnpm dev`

### DX_ROADMAP.md

- Updated DX Assessment scores to reflect current state (Error Messages, Helper Functions → ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐)
- Added **Audit Findings Summary** table with 10 categorized issues
- Phase 2 marked complete (9/9), Phase 3 expanded 10→16 items
- New **Phase 4.4: Codemod & Migration Tooling** section
- Refreshed Priority Matrix, Timeline Summary, Success Criteria with current metrics

### Examples Catalog Fixes

- Removed ghost `minimal-auth` reference, added `plugin-bi` section, updated metadata to v3.0.0
- Created `examples/plugin-bi/README.md` with purpose, quick start, next steps
- Added `typecheck` script + TS devDep to `plugin-bi/package.json`
- Fixed `app-host/README.md`: `npm run dev` → `pnpm dev`
